projects.title: Vikara Voice Agent
projects.description: Real-time conversational AI with voice streaming, powered by WebSocket and Google Gemini.
projects.longDescription: A full-stack voice AI system that enables natural spoken conversations with an AI agent. Features real-time speech-to-text, intelligent response generation via Google Gemini 2.0, and text-to-speech synthesis — all streaming over WebSocket for minimal latency.
projects.impact: Real-time voice AI with sub-second latency

projects.title: AI-IQ-TEAM
projects.description: AI-powered interview quality analysis with a 5-stage cognitive evaluation pipeline.
projects.longDescription: An intelligent system that evaluates interview quality through a multi-stage pipeline: Scribe (transcription) → Mapper (intent matching) → Detective (evidence extraction) → Judge (scoring) → Coach (feedback). Every score traces back to specific evidence — no score without proof.

projects.title: Excel Image Classifier
projects.description: CNN-based image classification system for automated visual quality analysis.
projects.longDescription: A computer vision system built for a Dubai-based client to automate image classification from Excel spreadsheets. Uses a custom CNN pipeline for image segmentation and classification, achieving 95% accuracy and reducing manual QA time by 80%.

projects.title: HR AutoLetter
projects.description: Automated offer letter generation from salary spreadsheets with template matching.
projects.longDescription: A React/TypeScript application that streamlines HR offer letter generation. Upload a salary calculation Excel sheet, select an employee, and generate a pixel-accurate offer letter matching the company template. Supports both HTML and custom DOCX templates.
